name: Say it Again
source:
It is an unconventional love story between Shizue; a lonely, socially challenged adult content creator and her new roommate Clementine; A fun loving, energetic art student, who has a few dark secrets of her own.

[From [url=https://gaerax.itch.io/say-it-again]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是静江之间非传统的爱情故事；一位孤独、有社交障碍的成人内容创作者和她的新室友克莱门汀；一位有趣、充满活力的艺术学生，她也有一些不为人知的秘密。

[来自[url=https://gaerax.itch.io/say-it-again]Itch.io[/url]]
